close_reason: Resolved via decision record on the variant doc. The variant stays unit-shaped because: (1) Display already interpolates MAX_MERGE_PATCH_DEPTH for log/UI use; (2) all 6 workspace consumers just map to InvalidPatch with a generic description, none destructure depth programmatically; (3) the finding's 'non-breaking' claim is wrong — changing a unit variant to a struct variant breaks pattern syntax even on #[non_exhaustive] (the existing 'if let Err(MergePatchError::DepthExceeded)' patterns would stop compiling). The additive escape hatch documented in the variant doc: a future consumer needing programmatic depth access can add a separate DepthExceededDetail variant alongside, with json_merge_patch emitting the new variant. Commit ed5011c.
title: MergePatchError::DepthExceeded carries no depth context — caller cannot log actual vs allowed
